visualCharacteristics.structure: category eyebrow + h3 title link + excerpt + read-more link + image + date
visualCharacteristics.layout: grid of white bordered cards, 1-up mobile / 2-up tablet / 3-up desktop; text above the image, date footer with a top rule. Feature option: 2-up shadowed cards with an h2 label (leading em word), larger title, pill CTA and 16:9 image. Pro option: borderless image-first cards (3:2 image, outlined tag pills, title, 32px round avatar + uppercase author • date), 1/2/3-up (2-up when exactly two cards), Load More pill revealing 9 more when there are more than 9 cards. Highlight option: one featured post, image (4:3) left / text right from 768px, tag pills, title, excerpt, byline, black pill Read More; the light panel comes from section style "light"
